title: Effective extraction and determination of 9 β-lactams in water and milk samples by a novel magnetic covalent organic framework combined with UPLC-MS/MS
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18657-18665
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09307D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lu Li, Na Li, Wendan Niu, Aijing Guo, Ling Ma, Wei Zhao, Yawei Zhang, Ke Wang
A novel magnetic covalent organic framework Fe3O4@SiO2@Ap-COF was designed and synthesized, which was used as an adsorbent for magnetic solid-phase extraction (MSPE) for the determination of 9 β-lactams.
